LANGUAGE: en
LEVEL: medium

database operations team here is the authoritative twenty-six step procedural runbook for tonight's cross-region postgresql high availability switchover drill. prior to beginning the drill verify that postgres query cancellation timeout is set to fifteen minutes to avoid orphaned query transactions. the compliance director requires that pci dss audit trails document all database administrative commands executed during maintenance. in addition verify that pg stat activity shows zero active idle in transaction queries before initiating connection pool termination. the cloud networking team confirmed that cross region direct connect latency between us east and us west averages thirty-eight milliseconds. finally verify that the database standby instance has at least sixty-four gigabytes of free ram to accommodate sudden connection spikes upon traffic cutover. step one verify that replication lag between the primary cluster in us east and the standby cluster in us west is strictly below one hundred milliseconds. step two verify disk space utilization across all database volumes in both regions remains strictly below seventy percent. step three post warning announcements to slack channel incident management and join the mandatory war room zoom bridge. step four redirect background read-only analytics queries to secondary read replicas to minimize lock contention. step five place the api gateway and client edge routers into read-only maintenance mode to prevent incoming write transactions during promotion. step six execute select pg current wal lsn on the primary database node to record the authoritative cutover log sequence position. step seven terminate active client backend connection pools using pg terminate backend on all application connections in us east. step eight execute checkpoint on the primary instance to flush all dirty shared memory buffers to persistent nvme disk volumes. step nine verify that the us west standby replica has received and replayed wal through the recorded cutover lsn without gap anomalies. step ten execute pg promote on the target standby node in us west and confirm that pg is in recovery returns false within five seconds. step eleven update route fifty-three internal database dns records to point primary dot db dot enterprise dot internal to the promoted us west endpoint. step twelve reconfigure pgpool and pgbouncer connection poolers with new upstream host addresses and reload connection listener sockets. step thirteen execute automated synthetic health check transactions on the promoted master to verify insert update and delete latency remains under ten milliseconds. step fourteen disable read-only maintenance mode on the edge api gateways and restore production application traffic to one hundred percent. step fifteen re-establish reverse streaming replication from us west to us east using pg basebackup or pg rewind to maintain secondary disaster recovery posture. step sixteen monitor grafana dashboards for thirty minutes tracking replication lag connection pool utilization and query error rates. step seventeen verify that automated database snapshot schedules in aws rds or aurora are re-synchronized across the promoted cluster. step eighteen ensure that postgres vacuum background workers resume table statistics maintenance after promotion without causing io saturation. step nineteen archive all pre switchover diagnostic log bundles and wal timeline history files to immutable s3 compliance buckets. step twenty conduct a fifteen-minute team debrief in the database slack channel to document lessons learned and approve ticket closure. step twenty-one verify that application connection pool latency drops below five milliseconds on the promoted primary node. step twenty-two verify that read replica lag across all secondary regions remains strictly below fifty milliseconds. step twenty-three re-enable automated cron maintenance jobs and vacuum scheduler workers on the primary database node. step twenty-four execute security compliance checks verifying that database encryption at rest remains enabled with aws kms keys. step twenty-five notify the incident commander and engineering executive leadership via pagerduty that failover completed successfully. step twenty-six close the change management ticket in service now with attached execution logs and performance graphs. incident commander confirmed that if replication replay stalls for more than sixty seconds during step nine we must abort the promotion and revert gateway traffic immediately. all participating database administrators and sre engineers must remain connected to the primary zoom bridge until post failover sign-off is completed. under no circumstances should any engineer modify pg hba dot conf to allow unauthenticated database connections during the failover transition. under no circumstances should any engineer restart database services during active wal replay without explicit approval from the incident commander. the compliance director mandates that full failover timeline audit logs be attached to the change management ticket within twenty-four hours. the security operations center must be notified immediately once production database traffic is restored to regular operations. the lead database architect confirmed that max connections on pgbouncer must be configured to two thousand connections with pool mode set to transaction. furthermore verify that postgres connection poolers set max connections to two thousand and idle connection timeout to thirty seconds. the site reliability team requires that grafana alerts for replication lag exceed threshold of one hundred milliseconds for three consecutive checks. in addition verify that database disk queue depth remains below two throughout the entire cutover window. the storage reliability team mandates that snapshot backups be triggered immediately after reverse streaming replication establishes clean sync. moreover verify that prometheus node exporter metrics for memory swap utilization remain at zero percent on all database host servers. finally verify that pg stat statements query execution statistics are reset to establish baseline performance on the promoted master node.
